capture_root: karrio-postnord/sandbox/ below the XDG state root (outside the repository)
redaction_policy: byte-identical copies of the captured evidence-of-record files; the sandbox customer number, printIds, bookingIds, item ids, the dummy EORI SE5561234711, and applicationId 7351 are artifact values the repo carve-out lets stand; the only secret is the 32-character apikey, which traveled as a query parameter already stripped at capture time — the build fails on any 32-character alphanumeric run the harness redactor's exemptions do not explain, and a PDF's trailer /ID document instance ids are the one binary exception

fixtures.description: 91 SE to AL booked through the connector with the mapper-built customsDeclarationCN23: accepted, bookingId and item id allocated, printoutComposition {cn23: 1, label: 1}, and the two SAO-HR-25060301 phone/sms sanitizations under handlingResponse.
fixtures.notes: captured before the printId-retention fix (33d085f): the printId fields hold the <redacted> sentinel and the printout digest list was masked by the pre-fix apikey heuristic (closed for later captures by 32ce7ec); P1's real printId was never retained anywhere and is unrecoverable, so the fixture keeps the sentinel.

fixtures.description: the composed printout of the CN23 booking: one two-page A4 PDF, page 1 the International Parcel label, page 2 the CN23 customs declaration; the first CN23-composed capture in this project or the fork, and the candidate source for deriving CN23 stamping seeds.
18 SE to AL commercial customs-invoice booking rejected with SAI-BR-24111201: id allocation precedes customs consideration, so the invoice branch cannot be exercised on this lane.
fixtures.notes: the fault explanation carries the sandbox customer number, an artifact value the repo carve-out lets stand.

fixtures.description: raw minimal 18 booking with no customs and no application object: the same SAI-BR-24111201 allocation fault as p2.
raw minimal 91 booking with no customs and no application object: rejected with SACUS-BR-24100901 demanding an applicationId, the customs-linkage gate with neither linkage present.
the p3-91 body unchanged plus the top-level application object carrying the configured four-digit application id: accepted, printoutComposition {label: 1} with every customs kind at 0.
fixtures.notes: captured after the printId fix (33d085f), so both printId fields are byte-real; the digest list was still masked (32ce7ec postdates the round).

fixtures.description: the bare one-page A4 label of the application-linked booking: with no customs declaration received, definePrintout=ALL prints no blank customs form.
HTTP 200 with per-id FAIL 'id not found' from the onlyCustomsDeclarations by-id fetch.
